ALTER TABLE [DW].[RefDepositVerifiedAccounts] 
ADD SCHM_TYPE VARCHAR(10)

ALTER TABLE [DW].[RefDepositVerifiedAccounts] 
ADD SCHM_CODE VARCHAR(10)

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_RefDepositVerifiedAccounts] @DatetoProcessed [DATE] AS
BEGIN

TRUNCATE TABLE [DW].[RefDepositVerifiedAccounts];

WITH CTE AS (
SELECT 
FORACID
, ACCT_OPN_DATE
, ISLATEST
, ENTITY_CRE_FLG
, BNK_CODE
, FILE_NAME
, SCHM_TYPE
, SCHM_CODE
, 0 WorkFlowI
, 0 TaskRunId
, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) InsertDttm
, ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY FORACID,BANK_ID ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME ,12),8) DESC) RN
FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER A
WHERE A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND A.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' AND LEFT(RIGHT(A.FILE_NAME,12),8) <= @DatetoProcessed 
)


INSERT INTO [DW].[RefDepositVerifiedAccounts] 
(
FORACID
, ACCT_OPN_DATE
, ISLATEST
, ENTITY_CRE_FLG
, BNK_CODE
, FILE_NAME
, SCHM_TYPE
, SCHM_CODE
, WorkFlowId
, TaskRunId
, InsertDttm 
)
SELECT 
FORACID
, ACCT_OPN_DATE
, 1
, ENTITY_CRE_FLG
, BNK_CODE
, FILE_NAME
, SCHM_TYPE
, SCHM_CODE
, 0
, 0
, InsertDttm
FROM CTE WHERE RN = 1




END
GO
